positive: Straight-on cross-polarized material scan, uniform diffuse illumination. This is a texture for a game mesh, every pixel is the same surface, edge to edge, no object outline, no scene or cast shadow. A 12-centimetre square scan filling the frame with a single sheet of old Japanese cast privacy glass, the tiny three-dimensional irregular seed and flowing fern pattern embossed in the glass seen by softly transmitted neutral grey light. Nearly colorless, delicate diffuse medium-grey relief on a pale smoky grey field, tightly packed minute ridges and flutes, restrained range. Face-on perpendicular, no room or view or objects visible through it, no window border, no metal wires, printed decoration or cracks.
